journey.title: Claim input
journey.description: The driver claims pending next-step input and a queued prompt. A turn can finish without spending a model step.

journey.title: Assemble and admit
journey.description: preStep assembles context and invokes agent/pre-step. Its decision may rewrite or reject the claimed messages.

journey.title: Prepare the request
journey.description: The driver prepares the model call, reconciles prompt/context and derives the request from the session log.

journey.title: Stream and settle
journey.description: Transient assistant frames serve live listeners. Successful or failed attempts are settled into durable session events.

journey.title: Schedule tools
journey.description: Exclusive calls form barriers; parallel calls use a bounded pool. Results remain in model order.

journey.title: Continue or stop
journey.description: Record step/end. Pending tool work or input can lead to another step; otherwise finish the turn.
